_comment: One reactive frame per floor (artspec.md section 5). 'approach' frames pick their painting when Miro first comes within 420 px (off screen), using every completed floor plus this one so far; 'entry' frames pick on arrival. A missing or unverified painting falls back to this slot's neutral painting, then to a sheet-covered frame. anchor: 'exit' places the frame relative to the floor's stair gate; 'point' uses the position as given. The frame snaps to the floor below and steps sideways until it is clear of stations, ladders and props.
